entries.title: 廣角街頭區域對焦 · 橋腹的人影｜全景交代
entries.titleEn: Wide zone-focused street · Figure beneath the bridge / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「廣角街頭區域對焦」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：28 mm 廣角配 f/8，預對焦，保留前中後景的關係；以現場光保留偶然人物位置，不要求排演。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a wide zone-focused street approach. Capture treatment: Pre-focus a 28 mm field at f/8 and keep foreground, middle distance and background connected; work with available light and incidental placements rather than staging. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：日常行走與有敘事線索的場景。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「廣角街頭區域對焦」。場景：窗邊的木工桌、刨花、卷尺與一盞關著的燈。光學與技法：28 mm 廣角配 f/8，預對焦，保留前中後景的關係；以現場光保留偶然人物位置，不要求排演。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：單窗柔光。色調：深棕、蜜茶、奶白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a carpenter's bench by a window, curls of wood, a tape measure and an unlit lamp using a wide zone-focused street approach. Capture treatment: Pre-focus a 28 mm field at f/8 and keep foreground, middle distance and background connected; work with available light and incidental placements rather than staging. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: soft light through one window. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「廣角街頭區域對焦」。場景：一隻海鳥站在窄礁石裂口，尾端朝向海面。光學與技法：28 mm 廣角配 f/8，預對焦，保留前中後景的關係；以現場光保留偶然人物位置，不要求排演。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：水面漫射光。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one seabird at a narrow rocky cleft with its tail facing the water using a wide zone-focused street approach. Capture treatment: Pre-focus a 28 mm field at f/8 and keep foreground, middle distance and background connected; work with available light and incidental placements rather than staging. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: diffuse reflected light from the water. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.titleEn: Telephoto street compression · Figure beneath the bridge / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「街頭長焦壓縮」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：以 135 mm 從遠處對焦，壓近重複輪廓與軸線；保留高反差邊緣，讓無關細節離焦。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a telephoto street compression approach. Capture treatment: Work from farther away at 135 mm, compressing repeated outlines and aligned axes; retain strong edge separation while defocusing incidental detail. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「街頭長焦壓縮」。場景：窗邊的木工桌、刨花、卷尺與一盞關著的燈。光學與技法：以 135 mm 從遠處對焦，壓近重複輪廓與軸線；保留高反差邊緣，讓無關細節離焦。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：單窗柔光。色調：深棕、蜜茶、奶白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a carpenter's bench by a window, curls of wood, a tape measure and an unlit lamp using a telephoto street compression approach. Capture treatment: Work from farther away at 135 mm, compressing repeated outlines and aligned axes; retain strong edge separation while defocusing incidental detail. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: soft light through one window. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「街頭長焦壓縮」。場景：一隻海鳥站在窄礁石裂口，尾端朝向海面。光學與技法：以 135 mm 從遠處對焦，壓近重複輪廓與軸線；保留高反差邊緣，讓無關細節離焦。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：水面漫射光。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one seabird at a narrow rocky cleft with its tail facing the water using a telephoto street compression approach. Capture treatment: Work from farther away at 135 mm, compressing repeated outlines and aligned axes; retain strong edge separation while defocusing incidental detail. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: diffuse reflected light from the water. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.titleEn: Candid phone documentary · Figure beneath the bridge / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「手機隨手紀錄」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：以偏廣角原生視野和自然手持高度保留小幅擺動感；不用美肌、去噪塗抹或精心美化小瑕疵。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a candid phone documentary approach. Capture treatment: Keep a slightly wide native phone field and a naturally imperfect handheld eye level; avoid beauty smoothing, aggressive noise reduction and polished imperfections. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「手機隨手紀錄」。場景：窗邊的木工桌、刨花、卷尺與一盞關著的燈。光學與技法：以偏廣角原生視野和自然手持高度保留小幅擺動感；不用美肌、去噪塗抹或精心美化小瑕疵。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：單窗柔光。色調：深棕、蜜茶、奶白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a carpenter's bench by a window, curls of wood, a tape measure and an unlit lamp using a candid phone documentary approach. Capture treatment: Keep a slightly wide native phone field and a naturally imperfect handheld eye level; avoid beauty smoothing, aggressive noise reduction and polished imperfections. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: soft light through one window. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one seabird at a narrow rocky cleft with its tail facing the water using a candid phone documentary approach. Capture treatment: Keep a slightly wide native phone field and a naturally imperfect handheld eye level; avoid beauty smoothing, aggressive noise reduction and polished imperfections. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: diffuse reflected light from the water. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a available-light reportage approach. Capture treatment: Use a 35 mm natural field and slight underexposure to retain scene-critical highlight information; wait for an informative instant without rearranging the location. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「直打閃燈快照」。場景：一位成年裁縫在工作台旁整理衣料，臉上有疲倦但專注的神情。光學與技法：相機軸線直打小閃燈，主體明亮而背景迅速失光；保留近距離硬影，讓框外黑暗不被補亮。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：直打閃光。色調：棕黑、乾玫瑰、暖灰。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a direct-flash snapshot approach. Capture treatment: Fire a small on-axis flash into a bright subject with rapid background falloff; preserve short hard shadows and leave the surroundings unfilled. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: near on-axis flash against ambient falloff. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult waiting in an unmarked raincoat, with a readable face inside the hood using a direct-flash snapshot approach. Capture treatment: Fire a small on-axis flash into a bright subject with rapid background falloff; preserve short hard shadows and leave the surroundings unfilled. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: near on-axis flash against ambient falloff. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：夜間快照與粗糙現場反差。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「直打閃燈快照」。場景：花瓣接縫上一滴水，後方僅有第二片花瓣影子。光學與技法：相機軸線直打小閃燈，主體明亮而背景迅速失光；保留近距離硬影，讓框外黑暗不被補亮。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：直打閃光。色調：梅紫、胭脂、淺粉米。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it using a direct-flash snapshot approach. Capture treatment: Fire a small on-axis flash into a bright subject with rapid background falloff; preserve short hard shadows and leave the surroundings unfilled. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: near on-axis flash against ambient falloff. Tonal palette: plum, muted rouge, pink shell. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：夜間快照與粗糙現場反差。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.titleEn: Monochrome silver-grain documentary · Figure beneath the bridge / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「黑白銀鹽紀實」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：以黑白銀鹽感的顆粒、暗部可讀的多階灰階呈現；讓場景重點靠明暗分離，不依賴色相。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：炭黑、銀灰、紙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a monochrome silver-grain documentary approach. Capture treatment: Favor monochrome silver-grain character, clear layered grays and readable shadows; separate scene information through luminance, not color. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「黑白銀鹽紀實」。場景：窗邊的木工桌、刨花、卷尺與一盞關著的燈。光學與技法：以黑白銀鹽感的顆粒、暗部可讀的多階灰階呈現；讓場景重點靠明暗分離，不依賴色相。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：單窗柔光。色調：炭黑、銀灰、紙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a carpenter's bench by a window, curls of wood, a tape measure and an unlit lamp using a monochrome silver-grain documentary approach. Capture treatment: Favor monochrome silver-grain character, clear layered grays and readable shadows; separate scene information through luminance, not color. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: soft light through one window. Tonal palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「黑白銀鹽紀實」。場景：一隻海鳥站在窄礁石裂口，尾端朝向海面。光學與技法：以黑白銀鹽感的顆粒、暗部可讀的多階灰階呈現；讓場景重點靠明暗分離，不依賴色相。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：水面漫射光。色調：炭黑、銀灰、紙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one seabird at a narrow rocky cleft with its tail facing the water using a monochrome silver-grain documentary approach. Capture treatment: Favor monochrome silver-grain character, clear layered grays and readable shadows; separate scene information through luminance, not color. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: diffuse reflected light from the water. Tonal palette: charcoal black, silver gray, paper white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.titleEn: Large softbox exposure · Late-shift tailor / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「大型柔光箱」。場景：一位成年裁縫在工作台旁整理衣料，臉上有疲倦但專注的神情。光學與技法：把大面積光源靠近主體，讓陰影有柔和半影與可預測衰減；以黑板吸收少量雜光，保留形體。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：近距大型柔光箱。色調：棕黑、乾玫瑰、暖灰。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a large softbox exposure approach. Capture treatment: Place a large modifier near the subject for soft penumbrae and predictable falloff; use a small negative fill to preserve form. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: a close broad softbox. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「大型柔光箱」。場景：穿無標記雨衣的成年人等候，兜帽下臉部輪廓清楚。光學與技法：把大面積光源靠近主體，讓陰影有柔和半影與可預測衰減；以黑板吸收少量雜光，保留形體。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：近距大型柔光箱。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult waiting in an unmarked raincoat, with a readable face inside the hood using a large softbox exposure approach. Capture treatment: Place a large modifier near the subject for soft penumbrae and predictable falloff; use a small negative fill to preserve form. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: a close broad softbox. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「大型柔光箱」。場景：花瓣接縫上一滴水，後方僅有第二片花瓣影子。光學與技法：把大面積光源靠近主體，讓陰影有柔和半影與可預測衰減；以黑板吸收少量雜光，保留形體。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：近距大型柔光箱。色調：梅紫、胭脂、淺粉米。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it using a large softbox exposure approach. Capture treatment: Place a large modifier near the subject for soft penumbrae and predictable falloff; use a small negative fill to preserve form. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: a close broad softbox. Tonal palette: plum, muted rouge, pink shell. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：人像、商品與平滑曲面。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.titleEn: Rembrandt triangle lighting · Late-shift tailor / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「三角側光」。場景：一位成年裁縫在工作台旁整理衣料，臉上有疲倦但專注的神情。光學與技法：把主光抬高並側移，讓陰面形成封閉三角光區；低比例回填，但保留清楚的亮暗分界。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：高位三角側光。色調：棕黑、乾玫瑰、暖灰。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a rembrandt triangle lighting approach. Capture treatment: Raise and offset the key so it creates a closed triangle of light on the shadow-facing plane; use little fill and retain a readable shadow boundary. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: a raised offset key making triangular light. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：立體表面及中高反差人像。此配方重點：環境尺度。

Capture treatment: Raise and offset the key so it creates a closed triangle of light on the shadow-facing plane; use little fill and retain a readable shadow boundary. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: a raised offset key making triangular light. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：立體表面及中高反差人像。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a clamshell lighting approach. Capture treatment: Key with a soft source above and raise shadows using a reflector below; keep the upper source stronger and avoid reverse shadows or featureless flat light. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: an upper key with weaker reflected light below. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「上下柔光補亮」。場景：成人手持一枝帶小葉子的莖，葉枝在中段展開。光學與技法：上方柔光作主光，下方反光板抬起陰影；上光較亮，避免反向陰影或無形體的全平光。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：上主下補的棚燈。色調：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult hand holding a single small-leaved stem opening out at the middle using a clamshell lighting approach. Capture treatment: Key with a soft source above and raise shadows using a reflector below; keep the upper source stronger and avoid reverse shadows or featureless flat light. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: an upper key with weaker reflected light below. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：美容、靜物與潔淨質感。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「輪廓背光」。場景：三條斜折面接到垂直立面，窄投影切入中段。光學與技法：從背側窄束加光，只描出外緣和半透明材質；保持正面比邊光低一到兩級而有細節。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：窄輪廓背光。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of three tilted planes meeting a vertical wall with a narrow cast shadow through the middle using a edge-rim photography approach. Capture treatment: Add narrow rear-side light that traces outer edges and translucent material; keep the front one to two stops lower while retaining detail. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: a narrow rear rim source. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：剪影分離與透明材質。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.title: 單窗自然光 · 晚班裁縫｜全景交代
entries.titleEn: Single-window natural light · Late-shift tailor / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「單窗自然光」。場景：一位成年裁縫在工作台旁整理衣料，臉上有疲倦但專注的神情。光學與技法：一側窗作唯一主光，逐步遠離窗面取得深暗背景；控制窗影，僅在需要時用白卡輕補。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：單窗漸弱自然光。色調：棕黑、乾玫瑰、暖灰。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a single-window natural light approach. Capture treatment: Use one window as the key and move away from it to darken the background naturally; manage window shadows and use a white card only for slight fill. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: fading light from one window. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：居家桌面與親密感敘事。此配方重點：環境尺度。

parameters.構圖: 範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「單窗自然光」。場景：透明薄杯的下緣、堆成斜線的氣泡和深色背景。光學與技法：一側窗作唯一主光，逐步遠離窗面取得深暗背景；控制窗影，僅在需要時用白卡輕補。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：單窗漸弱自然光。色調：深灰、藍白、霧紫。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of the lower rim of a thin clear glass with bubbles forming a diagonal against a dark background using a single-window natural light approach. Capture treatment: Use one window as the key and move away from it to darken the background naturally; manage window shadows and use a white card only for slight fill. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: fading light from one window. Tonal palette: deep gray, blue-white, misty mauve. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a wooden bench on light stone flooring beside a narrow door left ajar using a single-window natural light approach. Capture treatment: Use one window as the key and move away from it to darken the background naturally; manage window shadows and use a white card only for slight fill. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: fading light from one window. Tonal palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「單窗自然光」。場景：三條斜折面接到垂直立面，窄投影切入中段。光學與技法：一側窗作唯一主光，逐步遠離窗面取得深暗背景；控制窗影，僅在需要時用白卡輕補。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：單窗漸弱自然光。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of three tilted planes meeting a vertical wall with a narrow cast shadow through the middle using a single-window natural light approach. Capture treatment: Use one window as the key and move away from it to darken the background naturally; manage window shadows and use a white card only for slight fill. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: fading light from one window. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：居家桌面與親密感敘事。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.titleEn: Hard gobo projection · Centripetal bands / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「硬光遮片投影」。場景：兩條厚帶和一條細帶互相穿過，留一個不封閉的中心。光學與技法：單一硬光穿過遮片，在表面投下明確幾何陰影；保留投影邊界，不用另外的霧面柔光抵消效果。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：切割投影硬光。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of two broad bands and one narrow band crossing without closing the center using a hard gobo projection approach. Capture treatment: Send one hard source through a mask and project defined geometric shadows onto a surface; keep projected shadow boundaries instead of canceling the effect with soft fill. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard projected light cut by a mask. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：構成圖、硬邊與建築投影。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「硬光遮片投影」。場景：透明薄杯的下緣、堆成斜線的氣泡和深色背景。光學與技法：單一硬光穿過遮片，在表面投下明確幾何陰影；保留投影邊界，不用另外的霧面柔光抵消效果。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：切割投影硬光。色調：深灰、藍白、霧紫。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of the lower rim of a thin clear glass with bubbles forming a diagonal against a dark background using a hard gobo projection approach. Capture treatment: Send one hard source through a mask and project defined geometric shadows onto a surface; keep projected shadow boundaries instead of canceling the effect with soft fill. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: hard projected light cut by a mask. Tonal palette: deep gray, blue-white, misty mauve. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：構成圖、硬邊與建築投影。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「硬光遮片投影」。場景：一片反覆摺疊的亞麻，縫線跨過三個折面。光學與技法：單一硬光穿過遮片，在表面投下明確幾何陰影；保留投影邊界，不用另外的霧面柔光抵消效果。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：切割投影硬光。色調：炭灰、燕麥、象牙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one repeatedly folded linen sheet with a seam across three planes using a hard gobo projection approach. Capture treatment: Send one hard source through a mask and project defined geometric shadows onto a surface; keep projected shadow boundaries instead of canceling the effect with soft fill. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard projected light cut by a mask. Tonal palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「硬光遮片投影」。場景：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。光學與技法：單一硬光穿過遮片，在表面投下明確幾何陰影；保留投影邊界，不用另外的霧面柔光抵消效果。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：切割投影硬光。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall using a hard gobo projection approach. Capture treatment: Send one hard source through a mask and project defined geometric shadows onto a surface; keep projected shadow boundaries instead of canceling the effect with soft fill. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: hard projected light cut by a mask. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：構成圖、硬邊與建築投影。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.titleEn: Fast short-telephoto separation · Late-shift tailor / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「中長焦淺景深」。場景：一位成年裁縫在工作台旁整理衣料，臉上有疲倦但專注的神情。光學與技法：85 mm f/1.8，自然透視並讓背景離焦；主閱讀面對焦，明顯保留前後景差。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：側窗光。色調：棕黑、乾玫瑰、暖灰。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a fast short-telephoto separation approach. Capture treatment: Use an 85 mm f/1.8 field for natural perspective and a blurred background; focus on the primary reading plane and keep foreground/background separation obvious. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: soft lateral window light. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：半身人像及重點取景。此配方重點：環境尺度。

parameters.構圖: 範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「中長焦淺景深」。場景：成人手持一枝帶小葉子的莖，葉枝在中段展開。光學與技法：85 mm f/1.8，自然透視並讓背景離焦；主閱讀面對焦，明顯保留前後景差。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：一側柔和反射光。色調：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult hand holding a single small-leaved stem opening out at the middle using a fast short-telephoto separation approach. Capture treatment: Use an 85 mm f/1.8 field for natural perspective and a blurred background; focus on the primary reading plane and keep foreground/background separation obvious. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: soft reflected light from one side. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：半身人像及重點取景。此配方重點：主細節。

parameters.構圖: 靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of the lower rim of a thin clear glass with bubbles forming a diagonal against a dark background using a fast short-telephoto separation approach. Capture treatment: Use an 85 mm f/1.8 field for natural perspective and a blurred background; focus on the primary reading plane and keep foreground/background separation obvious. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: narrow edge light on a dark field. Tonal palette: deep gray, blue-white, misty mauve. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「等倍微距」。場景：透明薄杯的下緣、堆成斜線的氣泡和深色背景。光學與技法：100 mm 微距接近 1:1，展示通常看不見的微小紋理；在焦平面上安排主細節，容許周邊自然離焦。取景：以窄層焦點孤立單一小片，周圍不干擾主形。照明：黑底窄輪廓光。色調：深灰、藍白、霧紫。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of the lower rim of a thin clear glass with bubbles forming a diagonal against a dark background using a life-size macro approach. Capture treatment: Work at close to 1:1 with a 100 mm macro lens to reveal ordinarily invisible texture; align key detail with the focus plane and allow peripheral blur. Framing: Isolate a single small element with a narrow focal plane and uncluttered surroundings. Lighting: narrow edge light on a dark field. Tonal palette: deep gray, blue-white, misty mauve. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：質感、花蕊、飾品。此配方重點：標本式局部。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「深焦堆疊」。場景：一件雙耳粗陶罐、少量細砂和一小片藍布。光學與技法：從近至遠多段補焦合成；微小表面仍清楚；不加入景深光圈不可能形成的重影。取景：讓主紋理橫過焦面，構圖保留一段可讀輪廓。照明：擦過表面的側光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one two-handled earthenware vessel, scattered fine sand and a small blue cloth using a depth-stacked close study approach. Capture treatment: Merge controlled focus steps from near to far so small surfaces remain legible; avoid double edges or implausible blur transitions between surfaces. Framing: Carry the main texture through the focus plane with one recognizable edge. Lighting: raking light across the surface. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：結構展示、近距離細部。此配方重點：局部材質。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「移軸校正攝影」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：用移軸鏡頭水平對齊相機，保留垂直線不收斂；地平線與構圖分開控制，避免數位拉伸感。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a shift-corrected perspective approach. Capture treatment: Level the camera and shift the lens to preserve verticals without convergence; control horizon and framing separately and avoid a stretched digital look. entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「移軸校正攝影」。場景：淺石地面上有一張木凳，旁邊是半開的窄門。光學與技法：用移軸鏡頭水平對齊相機，保留垂直線不收斂；地平線與構圖分開控制，避免數位拉伸感。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：開門透入的窄幅日光。色調：炭灰、燕麥、象牙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a wooden bench on light stone flooring beside a narrow door left ajar using a shift-corrected perspective approach. Capture treatment: Level the camera and shift the lens to preserve verticals without convergence; control horizon and framing separately and avoid a stretched digital look. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: a narrow strip of daylight through the doorway. Tonal palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a curved fisheye view approach. Capture treatment: Use an extreme fisheye with visible barrel curvature near the edges; keep the critical subject near the less distorted center. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「雙焦面局部銳利」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：在鏡頭半側加近攝片，使近景和遠景各有一平面清晰；讓落差邊界落在暗部或形體邊緣。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a split-diopter dual focus approach. Capture treatment: Place a diopter over half of the lens for separate near and far planes of sharpness; hide the transition at a dark seam or a form boundary. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：前後景並陳與不尋常的聚焦。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「雙焦面局部銳利」。場景：淺石地面上有一張木凳，旁邊是半開的窄門。光學與技法：在鏡頭半側加近攝片，使近景和遠景各有一平面清晰；讓落差邊界落在暗部或形體邊緣。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：開門透入的窄幅日光。色調：炭灰、燕麥、象牙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a wooden bench on light stone flooring beside a narrow door left ajar using a split-diopter dual focus approach. Capture treatment: Place a diopter over half of the lens for separate near and far planes of sharpness; hide the transition at a dark seam or a form boundary. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: a narrow strip of daylight through the doorway. Tonal palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「柔階彩負底片」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：以細粒彩負風格處理飽和度、柔和高光肩和中性灰；保留天然材質，不用漂白黑位。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a soft color-negative palette approach. Capture treatment: Treat saturation with a fine-grained color-negative look, a soft highlight shoulder and neutral grays; retain natural surfaces rather than washing the blacks entirely. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：日常觀察與柔和色彩。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an empty crossroads after rain with two street lights drawing interrupted reflections using a soft color-negative palette approach. Capture treatment: Treat saturation with a fine-grained color-negative look, a soft highlight shoulder and neutral grays; retain natural surfaces rather than washing the blacks entirely. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: two practical sources with distinct color temperatures. Tonal palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：日常觀察與柔和色彩。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「高彩透明正片」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：正片感對比，中灰厚實，純色鮮明，高光準確；亮部臨界仍保留顏色，不過度抬黑。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a high-chroma reversal color approach. Capture treatment: Use slide-like contrast, solid midtones, vivid chroma and precise exposure; preserve hue close to highlights instead of lifting blacks. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「高彩透明正片」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：正片感對比，中灰厚實，純色鮮明，高光準確；亮部臨界仍保留顏色，不過度抬黑。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a high-chroma reversal color approach. Capture treatment: Use slide-like contrast, solid midtones, vivid chroma and precise exposure; preserve hue close to highlights instead of lifting blacks. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：艷色風景與清楚色塊。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「即影成像色移」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：保留溫暖白點和陰影青綠色移，銳度輕微降低；邊角密度稍有變化，不加品牌框或文字。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：透亮陰天。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a instant-print color shift approach. Capture treatment: Retain a warm white point and cyan-green shadow shift with softly reduced sharpness; vary corner density slightly without any branded border or print text. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: bright overcast light. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：回憶碎片與小品紀錄。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「即影成像色移」。場景：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。光學與技法：保留溫暖白點和陰影青綠色移，銳度輕微降低；邊角密度稍有變化，不加品牌框或文字。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：狹巷反射光。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall using a instant-print color shift approach. Capture treatment: Retain a warm white point and cyan-green shadow shift with softly reduced sharpness; vary corner density slightly without any branded border or print text. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: reflected light within the narrow alley. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：回憶碎片與小品紀錄。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「銀保留高反差」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：加深黑部並壓低多數色相飽和，保留亮部灰銀層次；中灰反差集中在紋理，而非全畫面過銳。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a bleach-bypass contrast approach. Capture treatment: Deepen blacks and suppress most chroma with layered silvery highlights; concentrate midtone contrast on texture, not sharpening everywhere. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：粗礫材質和冷硬氣氛。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「銀保留高反差」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：加深黑部並壓低多數色相飽和，保留亮部灰銀層次；中灰反差集中在紋理，而非全畫面過銳。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：透亮陰天。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a bleach-bypass contrast approach. Capture treatment: Deepen blacks and suppress most chroma with layered silvery highlights; concentrate midtone contrast on texture, not sharpening everywhere. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: bright overcast light. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：粗礫材質和冷硬氣氛。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「銀保留高反差」。場景：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。光學與技法：加深黑部並壓低多數色相飽和，保留亮部灰銀層次；中灰反差集中在紋理，而非全畫面過銳。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：狹巷反射光。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall using a bleach-bypass contrast approach. Capture treatment: Deepen blacks and suppress most chroma with layered silvery highlights; concentrate midtone contrast on texture, not sharpening everywhere. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: reflected light within the narrow alley. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：粗礫材質和冷硬氣氛。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「遠紅外亮葉效果」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：以近紅外感的亮植被與暗天空建立反常亮度；正常保留硬物幾何，不套隨機假色。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a near-infrared tonal effect approach. Capture treatment: Render near-infrared-like bright vegetation and an unusually dark sky; retain credible hard-object geometry instead of random false color. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「遠紅外亮葉效果」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：以近紅外感的亮植被與暗天空建立反常亮度；正常保留硬物幾何，不套隨機假色。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：透亮陰天。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a near-infrared tonal effect approach. Capture treatment: Render near-infrared-like bright vegetation and an unusually dark sky; retain credible hard-object geometry instead of random false color. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: bright overcast light. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：景物調性反轉與實驗視角。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「金時斜光風景」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：低角度暖斜光穿過遠近層，暗面偏冷；注意亮暗交界和疊層，使用自然光影而非橙色濾鏡。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：曙暮低角度光。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a golden-hour side light approach. Capture treatment: Rake warm low-angle light over near and far layers with cooler shaded planes; use natural highlight transitions and layering rather than a uniform orange filter. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: low golden-hour grazing light. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：層次地貌、城市天際線。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of four heavy columns and one bright doorway in progressively deeper bays using a golden-hour side light approach. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「金時斜光風景」。場景：橫越平靜水面的舊木棧橋，底下有緩慢水紋。光學與技法：低角度暖斜光穿過遠近層，暗面偏冷；注意亮暗交界和疊層，使用自然光影而非橙色濾鏡。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：曙暮低角度光。色調：深夜藍、電光青、鎢絲金。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an old timber pier across still water with slow ripples underneath using a golden-hour side light approach. Capture treatment: Rake warm low-angle light over near and far layers with cooler shaded planes; use natural highlight transitions and layering rather than a uniform orange filter. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: low golden-hour grazing light. Tonal palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：層次地貌、城市天際線。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an empty crossroads after rain with two street lights drawing interrupted reflections using a golden-hour side light approach. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: low golden-hour grazing light. Tonal palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.title: 陰天質地觀察 · 潮霧山脊｜全景交代
entries.titleEn: Overcast architectural study · Tidal mist ridge / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「陰天質地觀察」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：陰天的均勻光令材料顏色和少量接縫清楚；保留鉛灰天空與深度梯度，不硬推反差。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：均勻陰天體積光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a overcast architectural study approach. Capture treatment: Use even overcast light to make materials and small panel joints legible; keep a leaden sky and depth gradients without forcing contrast. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: even overcast ambient light. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：現代建築與材料調查。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「陰天質地觀察」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：陰天的均勻光令材料顏色和少量接縫清楚；保留鉛灰天空與深度梯度，不硬推反差。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：均勻陰天體積光。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a overcast architectural study approach. Capture treatment: Use even overcast light to make materials and small panel joints legible; keep a leaden sky and depth gradients without forcing contrast. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: even overcast ambient light. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：現代建築與材料調查。此配方重點：主細節。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of four heavy columns and one bright doorway in progressively deeper bays using a overcast architectural study approach. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: even overcast ambient light. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「藍調時刻光色」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：以深藍環境和局部暖人造光形成色溫分區；校正個別區域而非把整個畫面白平衡成一色。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：藍調暮光與暖色燈。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a blue-hour mixed-light scene approach. Capture treatment: Contrast deep blue ambient light with local warm fixtures as distinct temperature regions; correct locally rather than forcing a single white balance across the whole scene. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: blue ambient dusk with warm practical lights. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：傍晚城市、海岸與室內外連接。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「藍調時刻光色」。場景：橫越平靜水面的舊木棧橋，底下有緩慢水紋。光學與技法：以深藍環境和局部暖人造光形成色溫分區；校正個別區域而非把整個畫面白平衡成一色。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：藍調暮光與暖色燈。色調：深夜藍、電光青、鎢絲金。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an old timber pier across still water with slow ripples underneath using a blue-hour mixed-light scene approach. Capture treatment: Contrast deep blue ambient light with local warm fixtures as distinct temperature regions; correct locally rather than forcing a single white balance across the whole scene. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: blue ambient dusk with warm practical lights. Tonal palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「夜間現場燈光黑色電影感」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：利用現場可見的小型燈具、深陰影與鏡面反光；至少保留一條可讀的主體亮邊，不用全景霓虹。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：不均勻夜景小光源。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a neo-noir practical lights approach. Capture treatment: Motivate light from visible practical sources with deep shadows and specular reflections; keep a readable subject edge instead of saturating the whole scene with neon. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: uneven scene-motivated local light at night. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「夜間現場燈光黑色電影感」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：利用現場可見的小型燈具、深陰影與鏡面反光；至少保留一條可讀的主體亮邊，不用全景霓虹。取景：靠近局部閱讀面，只讓一種形狀或材質掌握焦點。照明：不均勻夜景小光源。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a neo-noir practical lights approach. Capture treatment: Motivate light from visible practical sources with deep shadows and specular reflections; keep a readable subject edge instead of saturating the whole scene with neon. Framing: Close in on one reading plane and give focus to a single shape or material. Lighting: uneven scene-motivated local light at night. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a carpenter's bench by a window, curls of wood, a tape measure and an unlit lamp using a neo-noir practical lights approach. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: uneven scene-motivated local light at night. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「多幅拼接全景」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：用等曝光的相鄰視角組接，保留連續地平與原本大小關係；抑制明顯接縫、重複物件和不必要彎折。取景：維持橫幅連貫、從斜方向延伸至遠處，使每一段有可讀層次。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a stitched spatial panorama approach. Capture treatment: Combine overlapping equal-exposure views into a continuous horizon with consistent relative scale; avoid visible seams, object duplication and unnecessary bending. Framing: Retain a coherent panoramic ribbon with an oblique near-to-far line and legible segments. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：連續空間和廣闊環境。此配方重點：橫幅縱深。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a small piece of fern with frost on the edge against a dark ground with a faint watery impression using a orthographic flat lay approach. Capture treatment: Aim straight downward and space objects by how they are used together; align rectangular edges with the frame and avoid simulated oblique perspective. Framing: Maintain straight-down capture and align short edges to form a regular grid. Lighting: backlight passing through the leaf. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

Framing: Maintain straight-down capture with only one or two principal forms and abundant spacing. Lighting: backlight passing through the leaf. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「無縫背景型錄」。場景：花瓣接縫上一滴水，後方僅有第二片花瓣影子。光學與技法：在無縫紙上鋪柔光，物體及其接觸影清楚；保持材質色、不加場景雜物或漂浮懸空。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：無縫紙上寬柔光。色調：梅紫、胭脂、淺粉米。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it using a seamless product catalog approach. Capture treatment: Use soft fill on a seamless sweep with readable contact shadows under the object; preserve material color without props or unnatural floating. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: broad soft light on a seamless sweep. Tonal palette: plum, muted rouge, pink shell. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：商品材質與形狀確認。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a boot waiting to be repaired with a fine brush, linen thread and traces of wear using a seamless product catalog approach. Capture treatment: Use soft fill on a seamless sweep with readable contact shadows under the object; preserve material color without props or unnatural floating. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: broad soft light on a seamless sweep. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「真實使用情境照」。場景：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。光學與技法：把物件置入有具體用途的空間，呈現使用線索而不擺滿裝飾；以柔和局部光將事物和周圍材質聯繫。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：狹巷反射光。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall using a in-use lifestyle scene approach. Capture treatment: Place the object in a plausible setting and show how it is used without decorative clutter; connect the subject and surrounding materials with soft local light. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: reflected light within the narrow alley. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：工作桌、居家物件與日常品牌。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.titleEn: Back-side food photography · Steam above a bowl / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「食物側逆光」。場景：深陶碗內的清湯和寬麵，蒸氣細微可見。光學與技法：讓側逆光穿透薄邊，凸出油亮、水氣與表面凹凸；控制反光不溢白，保留食材真實色。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：蒸氣及邊緣側逆光。色調：深棕、蜜茶、奶白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of clear broth and broad noodles in a dark earthen bowl with subtle steam using a back-side food photography approach. Capture treatment: Rake back-side light through thin edges to reveal sheen, vapor, and surface texture; shape reflection without clipping and preserve honest ingredient color. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: back-side light through vapor and the edge. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：餐桌、食物和可透光材料。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「食物側逆光」。場景：成人的手將一杯飲品放在近窗桌上，杯墊略偏。光學與技法：讓側逆光穿透薄邊，凸出油亮、水氣與表面凹凸；控制反光不溢白，保留食材真實色。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：蒸氣及邊緣側逆光。色調：深棕、蜜茶、奶白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult hand setting a drink down on a table near the window with a slightly offset coaster using a back-side food photography approach. Capture treatment: Rake back-side light through thin edges to reveal sheen, vapor, and surface texture; shape reflection without clipping and preserve honest ingredient color. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: back-side light through vapor and the edge. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：餐桌、食物和可透光材料。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「食物側逆光」。場景：一件雙耳粗陶罐、少量細砂和一小片藍布。光學與技法：讓側逆光穿透薄邊，凸出油亮、水氣與表面凹凸；控制反光不溢白，保留食材真實色。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：蒸氣及邊緣側逆光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one two-handled earthenware vessel, scattered fine sand and a small blue cloth using a back-side food photography approach. Capture treatment: Rake back-side light through thin edges to reveal sheen, vapor, and surface texture; shape reflection without clipping and preserve honest ingredient color. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: back-side light through vapor and the edge. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：餐桌、食物和可透光材料。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.titleEn: Black-card glass lighting · Frosted fern frond / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「黑卡玻璃輪廓」。場景：一小段蕨葉，葉緣沾霜，暗底有輕微浮水印狀輪廓。光學與技法：用黑卡或窄條白反光板描出透明物體邊界；控制底材透視，不用全白抹去材質。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：窄輪廓燈與黑卡。色調：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a small piece of fern with frost on the edge against a dark ground with a faint watery impression using a black-card glass lighting approach. Capture treatment: Shape the edges of translucent objects with black flags or narrow white reflections; retain visibility through the object rather than filling it with white. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: a narrow tracing light with black cards. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：透明包裝、杯皿和工藝材質。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「黑卡玻璃輪廓」。場景：花瓣接縫上一滴水，後方僅有第二片花瓣影子。光學與技法：用黑卡或窄條白反光板描出透明物體邊界；控制底材透視，不用全白抹去材質。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：窄輪廓燈與黑卡。色調：梅紫、胭脂、淺粉米。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a single water drop at a petal seam with the shadow of a second petal behind it using a black-card glass lighting approach. Capture treatment: Shape the edges of translucent objects with black flags or narrow white reflections; retain visibility through the object rather than filling it with white. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: a narrow tracing light with black cards. Tonal palette: plum, muted rouge, pink shell. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：透明包裝、杯皿和工藝材質。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「黑卡玻璃輪廓」。場景：一件待修補的靴子、細刷、麻線和使用磨痕。光學與技法：用黑卡或窄條白反光板描出透明物體邊界；控制底材透視，不用全白抹去材質。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：窄輪廓燈與黑卡。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a boot waiting to be repaired with a fine brush, linen thread and traces of wear using a black-card glass lighting approach. Capture treatment: Shape the edges of translucent objects with black flags or narrow white reflections; retain visibility through the object rather than filling it with white. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: a narrow tracing light with black cards. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：透明包裝、杯皿和工藝材質。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「限色棚拍編輯照」。場景：一位成年裁縫在工作台旁整理衣料，臉上有疲倦但專注的神情。光學與技法：兩個純色材質搭配背景與輔助道具，讓色階可控；道具只提供比例或動線，不露假字樣。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：控制色塊的棚光。色調：棕黑、乾玫瑰、暖灰。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an adult tailor sorting cloth beside a table, with a tired but intent expression using a limited-color editorial studio approach. Capture treatment: Pair two solid-color materials across the ground and restrained props for controlled tonal steps; use props only for scale or visual movement without fake text. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: controlled studio light separating color blocks. Tonal palette: brown-black, dried rose, warm gray. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：封面、品項比較與色彩實驗。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「限色棚拍編輯照」。場景：窗邊的木工桌、刨花、卷尺與一盞關著的燈。光學與技法：兩個純色材質搭配背景與輔助道具，讓色階可控；道具只提供比例或動線，不露假字樣。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：控制色塊的棚光。色調：深棕、蜜茶、奶白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a carpenter's bench by a window, curls of wood, a tape measure and an unlit lamp using a limited-color editorial studio approach. Capture treatment: Pair two solid-color materials across the ground and restrained props for controlled tonal steps; use props only for scale or visual movement without fake text. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: controlled studio light separating color blocks. Tonal palette: deep umber, honey tea, cream. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：封面、品項比較與色彩實驗。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「限色棚拍編輯照」。場景：一件待修補的靴子、細刷、麻線和使用磨痕。光學與技法：兩個純色材質搭配背景與輔助道具，讓色階可控；道具只提供比例或動線，不露假字樣。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：控制色塊的棚光。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a boot waiting to be repaired with a fine brush, linen thread and traces of wear using a limited-color editorial studio approach. Capture treatment: Pair two solid-color materials across the ground and restrained props for controlled tonal steps; use props only for scale or visual movement without fake text. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: controlled studio light separating color blocks. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.titleEn: Panned motion capture · Bicycle crossing an alley / Movement in context
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「平移追焦」。場景：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。光學與技法：在較慢快門下跟拍，主體部分清楚，背景沿移動方向拉線；模糊方向一致，不用徑向縮放模糊代替。取景：留出下一段移動空間，使環境能交代方向和尺度。照明：狹巷反射光。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall using a panned motion capture approach. Capture treatment: Follow the subject with a slower shutter, leaving part of it sharp and streaking the background along motion; keep smear direction coherent rather than substituting radial zoom blur. Framing: Leave room for the next movement and keep environmental clues to direction and scale. Lighting: reflected light within the narrow alley. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：車輛、街道與移動中的生活。此配方重點：前進空間。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「平移追焦」。場景：橋墩下有一個推車的人，濕地只反出窄亮帶。光學與技法：在較慢快門下跟拍，主體部分清楚，背景沿移動方向拉線；模糊方向一致，不用徑向縮放模糊代替。取景：留出下一段移動空間，使環境能交代方向和尺度。照明：高反差斜側光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a panned motion capture approach. Capture treatment: Follow the subject with a slower shutter, leaving part of it sharp and streaking the background along motion; keep smear direction coherent rather than substituting radial zoom blur. Framing: Leave room for the next movement and keep environmental clues to direction and scale. Lighting: hard upper sidelight. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「平移追焦」。場景：一隻海鳥站在窄礁石裂口，尾端朝向海面。光學與技法：在較慢快門下跟拍，主體部分清楚，背景沿移動方向拉線；模糊方向一致，不用徑向縮放模糊代替。取景：留出下一段移動空間，使環境能交代方向和尺度。照明：水面漫射光。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one seabird at a narrow rocky cleft with its tail facing the water using a panned motion capture approach. Capture treatment: Follow the subject with a slower shutter, leaving part of it sharp and streaking the background along motion; keep smear direction coherent rather than substituting radial zoom blur. Framing: Leave room for the next movement and keep environmental clues to direction and scale. Lighting: diffuse reflected light from the water. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「高速閃光凝結」。場景：一輛正穿過窄巷的單車，牆上光帶斷續。光學與技法：用短閃光時間凝住碎片、液滴或動作邊線；讓動作瞬間合理，避免影隨物反方向。取景：留出下一段移動空間，使環境能交代方向和尺度。照明：短時閃燈。色調：鐵灰、紅鏽、杏黃。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a bicycle passing across a narrow alley with broken light bands on the wall using a short-flash motion freeze approach. Capture treatment: Freeze fragments, drops or action edges with a short flash duration; hold a physically plausible instant with shadows consistent with light. Framing: Leave room for the next movement and keep environmental clues to direction and scale. Lighting: short-duration flash. Tonal palette: iron gray, vermilion rust, apricot. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「雙重曝光疊影」。場景：兩條厚帶和一條細帶互相穿過，留一個不封閉的中心。光學與技法：把第二次曝光排入前一層暗區，避免所有區域均勻重疊；兩層輪廓可辨，避免變成普通透明拼貼。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：均勻無投影背景光。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of two broad bands and one narrow band crossing without closing the center using a double-exposure overlay approach. Capture treatment: Place the second exposure inside shadowed areas of the first rather than overlaying every area equally; keep both outlines legible instead of a uniformly transparent collage. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: even background light without distracting cast shadows. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：一張圖中的兩段時間或物件。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「雙重曝光疊影」。場景：三條斜折面接到垂直立面，窄投影切入中段。光學與技法：把第二次曝光排入前一層暗區，避免所有區域均勻重疊；兩層輪廓可辨，避免變成普通透明拼貼。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：高反差幾何投影。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of three tilted planes meeting a vertical wall with a narrow cast shadow through the middle using a double-exposure overlay approach. Capture treatment: Place the second exposure inside shadowed areas of the first rather than overlaying every area equally; keep both outlines legible instead of a uniformly transparent collage. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: high-contrast light making a geometric projection. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：一張圖中的兩段時間或物件。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「雙重曝光疊影」。場景：一小段蕨葉，葉緣沾霜，暗底有輕微浮水印狀輪廓。光學與技法：把第二次曝光排入前一層暗區，避免所有區域均勻重疊；兩層輪廓可辨，避免變成普通透明拼貼。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：透葉逆光。色調：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a small piece of fern with frost on the edge against a dark ground with a faint watery impression using a double-exposure overlay approach. Capture treatment: Place the second exposure inside shadowed areas of the first rather than overlaying every area equally; keep both outlines legible instead of a uniformly transparent collage. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: backlight passing through the leaf. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one repeatedly folded linen sheet with a seam across three planes using a double-exposure overlay approach. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: raking illumination at a low angle. Tonal palette: charcoal, oat, ivory. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「雙重曝光疊影」。場景：四根粗柱與一扇亮門，柱距逐級走向深處。光學與技法：把第二次曝光排入前一層暗區，避免所有區域均勻重疊；兩層輪廓可辨，避免變成普通透明拼貼。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：內暗外亮的局部光。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of four heavy columns and one bright doorway in progressively deeper bays using a double-exposure overlay approach. Capture treatment: Place the second exposure inside shadowed areas of the first rather than overlaying every area equally; keep both outlines legible instead of a uniformly transparent collage. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: localized light from the threshold. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：一張圖中的兩段時間或物件。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.titleEn: Pinhole exposure · Tidal mist ridge / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「針孔低解析成像」。場景：海風吹散三層山脊間的薄霧，近處為層狀淺岩。光學與技法：以針孔成像感的全幅柔銳、淡暗角和慢曝時移建構；線條軟而正直，避免魚眼式扭曲。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：破曉薄霧光。色調：礦灰、岩朱、白堊。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of marine mist separating three ridges, with stratified pale rock in the foreground using a pinhole exposure approach. Capture treatment: Use soft edge-to-edge resolution, subtle vignetting and slow-exposure motion associated with a pinhole; keep straight lines soft but straight, without fisheye distortion. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: pale dawn haze. Tonal palette: mineral gray, iron red, chalk. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：長時間凝視與靜態風景。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「針孔低解析成像」。場景：岸邊的一間小屋，暗色礁石和遠方海鳥。光學與技法：以針孔成像感的全幅柔銳、淡暗角和慢曝時移建構；線條軟而正直，避免魚眼式扭曲。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：透亮陰天。色調：深海藍、青瓷、沙白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one hut on a coast, dark rocks and a distant seabird using a pinhole exposure approach. Capture treatment: Use soft edge-to-edge resolution, subtle vignetting and slow-exposure motion associated with a pinhole; keep straight lines soft but straight, without fisheye distortion. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: bright overcast light. Tonal palette: marine blue, celadon, sand white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「針孔低解析成像」。場景：橫越平靜水面的舊木棧橋，底下有緩慢水紋。光學與技法：以針孔成像感的全幅柔銳、淡暗角和慢曝時移建構；線條軟而正直，避免魚眼式扭曲。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：淡靛傍晚光。色調：深夜藍、電光青、鎢絲金。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of an old timber pier across still water with slow ripples underneath using a pinhole exposure approach. Capture treatment: Use soft edge-to-edge resolution, subtle vignetting and slow-exposure motion associated with a pinhole; keep straight lines soft but straight, without fisheye distortion. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: faint indigo dusk light. Tonal palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：長時間凝視與靜態風景。此配方重點：留白版面。

Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: two practical sources with distinct color temperatures. Tonal palette: midnight blue, electric teal, tungsten gold. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.

entries.titleEn: Projected-image photography · Centripetal bands / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「表面投影攝影」。場景：兩條厚帶和一條細帶互相穿過，留一個不封閉的中心。光學與技法：將圖形投到實物表面，讓亮度與透視沿表面轉折；用少量環境光保留投影以外的真實紋理。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：可見主體的局部投影。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of two broad bands and one narrow band crossing without closing the center using a projected-image photography approach. Capture treatment: Project a visual shape onto a real surface and let brightness and geometry follow changes in angle; use mild ambient fill to retain real texture outside the projection. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: localized projection with readable substrate. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：多層光影實驗與3D表面。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「表面投影攝影」。場景：三條斜折面接到垂直立面，窄投影切入中段。光學與技法：將圖形投到實物表面，讓亮度與透視沿表面轉折；用少量環境光保留投影以外的真實紋理。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：可見主體的局部投影。色調：暗藍、赭橙、明淺砂。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of three tilted planes meeting a vertical wall with a narrow cast shadow through the middle using a projected-image photography approach. Capture treatment: Project a visual shape onto a real surface and let brightness and geometry follow changes in angle; use mild ambient fill to retain real texture outside the projection. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: localized projection with readable substrate. Tonal palette: navy, ochre-orange, pale sand. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：多層光影實驗與3D表面。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.titleEn: Projected-image photography · Frosted fern frond / Establishing view
entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「表面投影攝影」。場景：一小段蕨葉，葉緣沾霜，暗底有輕微浮水印狀輪廓。光學與技法：將圖形投到實物表面，讓亮度與透視沿表面轉折；用少量環境光保留投影以外的真實紋理。取景：範圍稍廣，建立環境比例，用前景作尺度參照。照明：可見主體的局部投影。色調：墨綠、苔灰、青檸點色。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of a small piece of fern with frost on the edge against a dark ground with a faint watery impression using a projected-image photography approach. Capture treatment: Project a visual shape onto a real surface and let brightness and geometry follow changes in angle; use mild ambient fill to retain real texture outside the projection. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: localized projection with readable substrate. Tonal palette: shadow green, moss gray, lime accent. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：多層光影實驗與3D表面。此配方重點：環境尺度。

entries.prompt: 生成一張具相機成像質感的原創影像，風格「表面投影攝影」。場景：四根粗柱與一扇亮門，柱距逐級走向深處。光學與技法：將圖形投到實物表面，讓亮度與透視沿表面轉折；用少量環境光保留投影以外的真實紋理。取景：主重心置於邊位，留約三分之一呼吸空間且不以假文字填滿。照明：可見主體的局部投影。色調：深靛、鉛灰、冷白。保留合理透視與材質反應（鏡頭或合成的刻意變形除外），無商標、浮水印或多餘文字。
entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of four heavy columns and one bright doorway in progressively deeper bays using a projected-image photography approach. Capture treatment: Project a visual shape onto a real surface and let brightness and geometry follow changes in angle; use mild ambient fill to retain real texture outside the projection. Framing: Offset the center of interest and leave approximately a third of the frame open with no filler typography. Lighting: localized projection with readable substrate. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
entries.use: 適用：多層光影實驗與3D表面。此配方重點：留白版面。

entries.promptEn: Make an original photographic image of one cart-pushing figure below an elevated bridge, with a narrow streak of reflection on the wet ground using a projected-image photography approach. Capture treatment: Project a visual shape onto a real surface and let brightness and geometry follow changes in angle; use mild ambient fill to retain real texture outside the projection. Framing: Include more surroundings, establish scale with a near element, and keep a legible context. Lighting: localized projection with readable substrate. Tonal palette: deep indigo, lead gray, cold white. Preserve plausible material response and the specified optical treatment; no logos, watermark, or extraneous type.
